message.content: {"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"В Абу-Даби планируют открыть мостовой комплекс на острове Рамхан во втором квартале 2027 года.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Проект включает семь мостов, три туннеля и дорожную сеть, соединяющую острова Рамхан и Джубайл с шоссе Шейха Халифы (E12).","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3]},{"claim":"Общая площадь строительства превысит 166 000 кв. м.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Стоимость составит около 872 млн дирхамов.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"В проекте предусмотрены энергосберегающие LED-светильники.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"В проекте предусмотрена переработка 90% строительных отходов.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Sharjah temporarily closed all its beaches due to an oil spill.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,2]},{"claim":"The closure was done to prevent pollution and ensure safety.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3]},{"claim":"Al Hamriyah Beach was closed earlier on October 23.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"Similar measures were taken in Umm Al Quwain and Ras Al Khaimah, where all beaches are closed until assessments and protective measures are completed.","supported":true,"evidence":[10,11]},{"claim":"Fishermen temporarily do not go to sea.","supported":true,"evidence":[14]},{"claim":"Fresh supplies continue to arrive at Umm Al Quwain fish market from Oman.","supported":true,"evidence":[12,13]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The UAE launched an upgraded Wage Protection System (WPS) that enables employers to manage salary payments digitally without paperwork or visiting banks.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The system was developed with the participation of the Central Bank of the UAE and Al Etihad Payments.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The upgraded system enables real-time data exchange and is connected to 17 financial institutions including major banks and exchange centers.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The WPS covers more than 99% of private-sector workers with average monthly wage transfers of about AED 37 billion.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The upgraded platform accelerates salary processing, increases transparency, and supports financial inclusion aligned with the We the UAE 2031 strategy.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,3] }]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai Future Foundation through Sandbox Dubai launched AI Sandbox to help companies overcome regulatory barriers and deploy AI solutions in practice.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,2]},{"claim":"The project involves startups, technology companies, and government entities including Dubai Centre for Artificial Intelligence.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Participants receive support in technical, policy, commercial issues, and regulatory requirements.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Applications are open until 18 December 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[12]},{"claim":"The initiative aims to accelerate AI commercialization and adapt regulatory frameworks to new technologies.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,6,7,8]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Construction has started on two pedestrian bridges on Palm Jumeirah in Dubai.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The first bridge near Shoreline is planned to be completed by June 2027.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The second bridge near Golden Mile is planned to be completed by October 2027.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"The combined capacity of the two bridges will be 2700 pedestrians per hour, exceeding current demand and allowing for future growth.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"The project is a joint effort by RTA and Dubai Holding Community Management.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,4]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Фестиваль шейха Зайеда стартует 30 октября в Аль-Ватбе","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"В Абу-Даби откроется новый сезон фестиваля шейха Зайеда, который продлится 135 дней","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Фестиваль предложит культурные, спортивные и развлекательные мероприятия с участием арабских и международных артистов","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3]},{"claim":"В программе — концерты, традиционные выступления, лазерные шоу, рынок, а также павильоны с национальными культурами и гастрономией","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]},{"claim":"Фестиваль работает ежедневно с 16:00 до полуночи, по выходным — до 1:00","supported":true,"evidence":[6]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"From October 30 to November 1, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Sharjah will have road closures, lane restrictions, and new speed limits.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,13,20]},{"claim":"On November 1 in Dubai, Salik toll rates will change with variable charges: 6 dirhams during peak hours, 4 dirhams during off-peak hours, and free at night.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"Dubai Metro will operate from 3 am on November 1 to accommodate Dubai Ride 2026 participants.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"Special parking locations for Dubai Ride 2026 are at Dubai World Trade Centre, Dubai Mall, and Zabeel.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"Speed limits will change on several Dubai roads on November 1.","supported":true,"evidence":[7,8]},{"claim":"Emirates Road will have overnight closures until November 15 due to railway construction.","supported":true,"evidence":[9,10]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Registration for the sixth season of the Farmers’ Market in Dubai is open.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The Farmers’ Market will run from 28 November 2026 to 31 January 2027 at Quranic Park in Al Khawaneej.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The market will operate on weekends.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The market will feature 52 Emirati farmers and local entrepreneurs.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"For the first time, there will be 10 spaces for children under the \"Young Farmers and Entrepreneurs\" initiative, allowing them to sell products and develop skills in agriculture and business.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In the UAE, new fuel prices for November 2026 were approved.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The price of petrol fell by 5.6% compared to October 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The price of diesel fell by 1.04% compared to October 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The new prices are: Super 98 - 4.16 AED per litre.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"The new prices are: Special 95 - 4.04 AED per litre.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The new prices are: E-Plus 91 - 3.97 AED per litre.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The new price for diesel is 4.75 AED per litre.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In November 2026, Dubai will launch two initiatives to improve the tourist experience.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3]},{"claim":"One initiative is the world's first city-led, invitation-only tourism membership programme called Dubai Access Club.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,5]},{"claim":"The other initiative is the ability to apply for tourist visas through the official Visit Dubai website.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,7,9]},{"claim":"Dubai Access Club will offer members exclusive services and benefits to encourage repeat visits.","supported":true,"evidence":[5,6]},{"claim":"Applying for visas through Visit Dubai will simplify the application process and unify services in one digital platform.","supported":true,"evidence":[7,8,9]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In December, the largest Marks & Spencer food hall outside the UK will open at Dubai Festival City with an area of 15,327 sq ft.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The store will carry the full M&S Food range, including more than 3,500 core products and 500 locally sourced products.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Fresh M&S flowers will make their international debut in the region for the first time.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The Middle East will get its first M&S Patisserie.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"The store will have sushi, rotisserie chicken, pizza, and a coffee shop counters.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"The store offers a wide range of ready meals and products for convenient shopping.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,5,7]},{"claim":"The partnership between Al-Futtaim and M&S has lasted nearly 30 years.","supported":true,"evidence":[8,10]},{"claim":"The first M&S store in Dubai opened in 1998.","supported":true,"evidence":[9]},{"claim":"The new food hall will set a new benchmark for food retail in the UAE.","supported":true,"evidence":[7,8]}]}
